chapter_title_en: The First Charge of the Realm War
chapter_seo_title: Realm War: Ji Ning’s Xingtian Shatters the Seamless Gate in First Contact
chapter_meta_description: The ceasefire is over. Ji Ning leads a Xingtian formation against the Seamless Gate’s war-beasts, demolishing a Zhu’yan in the opening clash. But the three demon-saints of Mount Tunlong have marked him for death.
og_title: Realm War: Ji Ning’s Xingtian Unleashed
og_description: The first charge of the war is here. Watch Ji Ning smash an enemy formation and face the legendary Golden Eagle in a battle of pure strength.
twitter_title: Ji Ning vs. the Three Demon-Saints
twitter_description: The Realm War begins with a clash of Xingtian gods. Ji Ning takes on a Zhu’yan and immediately draws the ire of the fastest demon-saint in the Three Realms.

lore_anchors.definition: A massive war formation transforming countless Celestial Immortals and Loose Immortals into a single, colossal divine warrior. The power scales with the number of command staff and the formation's total cultivator base.
In Chinese mythology, a white-furred ape with red feet, considered an omen of war. In Desolate Era, it is a powerful formation-manifested battle beast used by the Seamless Gate's elite forces.
A Ki Refiner who has successfully transformed their Golden Core into Pure Yang, granting them vastly superior power over ordinary True Immortals and setting them on the path toward Daofather-hood.
Three legendary, top-tier combatants of the Seamless Gate: the speed-supreme Golden Eagle, the broken-horned flood dragon, and the nine-headed lion, each a force of nature on the battlefield.
A Xianxia concept representing a realm’s accumulated destiny and luck. Losing one’s qi of fortune makes a world vulnerable to conquest.
The highest level of conflict in the Three Realms, pitting entire realmverses and their Daofather-level forces against each other.
A Seamless Gate battle formation made of 1,000 Celestial Immortals and 100,000 Loose Immortals, manifesting as a powerful serpentine dragon.
